channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: CAVA: Free Bowl or Pita at CAVA's Community Day in Windermere: Reserve a Free Ticket
item.guid: CAVA-Free Bowl or Pita at CAVA's Communit-2026-11-17
item.description: Saturday, November 21 and Sunday, November 22: CAVA is giving one free bowl or pita per person at its new restaurant at 4757 The Grove Drive in Windermere, before it opens. You need a free ticket for a time slot (10:30 AM to 2 PM, 2 to 5 PM or 5 to 8 PM), reserved ahead on CAVA's own Eventbrite page, and each guest needs their own ticket. Tickets are limited: CAVA's Bethesda, Maryland day on November 23 is already sold out, so reserve now. CAVA invites a donation to a local food charity, but the meal is free. (Windermere, FL only (near Orlando) only) (Through November 22, 2026)

item.title: Top Pick: Potbelly: 50% Off an Original Sandwich or Wrap When You Buy a Bowl, Code BOWLS
item.guid: Potbelly-50% Off an Original Sandwich or Wrap Whe-2026-11-17
item.description: Through Sunday, November 22: order a bowl and an Original sandwich or wrap on potbelly.com or in the Potbelly app, enter code BOWLS at checkout, and the lower-priced of the two is half off. Once per order; online and app orders only; participating shops. The code and terms come from Potbelly's own promotion, but Potbelly does not show them on its public site, so if the code is refused at checkout the offer has been pulled. (Through November 22, 2026)
